subject.name: Dissertation
subject.course_or_branch: BA in Socialogy Psychology Political Science

content: Aims to provide intensive support throughout the writing process
This includes regular hourly six times a week meeting with a
dissertation guide/supervisor to discuss progress, methodology, and
writing. The guidance would be structured around a proposal
defense (synopsis), consistent progress review, a pre-submission
review, and a final defense preparation
Throughout the semester, students will learn to conduct self-directed
literature reviews, identify research gaps, and become proficient in
research methodology through database searches and source
evaluation. The work involves extensive reading, note-taking, data
collection, and drafting. It's assessed through an annotated
bibliography, a research methodology statement, reading logs, and
biweekly progress reports

chapters.chapter_name: Teaching Assistantship Includes fourth-year undergraduate students supporting/teaching
content: first-year undergraduate tutorials (4 hours), assignment proofreading
and assisting junior students with research (2 hours), and material
preparation like ppts and supplementary readings (2 hours). They
will also co-facilitate workshops on research skills, presentations
and academic writing. The fourth-year students can and will also
facilitate Practical classes for first year undergraduate students
